purpose: One bounded fixed-physics perturbation SOURCE time-grid refinement to separate LW03 transfer interpolation dependence from radial quadrature errors. Not full line of sight, independent integrator tolerance, or detection.

frozen_physics.physical_model: v063.theory_response_map.class_params; original AeST + NL0B positive Drude externally forced tangent
frozen_physics.forcing: sha-locked original LW01 forcing, never regenerate, exact same signed amplitudes

experiment.historical_reference: LW03 source-time get_transfer(z) data saved at original source precision: 65 chi nodes × 322 native Fourier k nodes for ell=100/150/200/300.
experiment.numerical_integration_tolerance: unchanged inherited CLASS default tol_perturbations_integration; not a tested axis
experiment.z_query_coordinates: exact same LW03 NPZ z_ell_{100,150,200,300}, no new redshift-domain extrapolation
experiment.radial_chi_quadrature: reuse exact LW03 65 original chi coordinates per ell; keep 17/33/65 historical FAIL untouched
experiment.source_of_class_param: pinned official CLASS include/precisions.h: perturbations_sampling_stepsize default 0.1 and source/perturbations.c tau_sampling stepsize

outcomes.caveat: A pass stabilizes W and dW on a revised source sampling grid within original windows and fixed 65-point lensing paths. It cannot rescue original LW03 radial FAIL or certify physical full lensing or detection.

stop_rule: One refined baseline/+2.5/-2.5 CLASS campaign only; preserve failures and never tune thresholds to results. If pass, separately evaluate requirements of full LOS/domain and independent integration accuracy before exposure to observed residuals; if fail, no observation claims.
